# The volunteer rota has a hidden bottleneck

Everyone can staff the desk, but only two people can reset the ticket printer. Their days off determine the rota more than visitor demand does. Write the reset procedure and test it on a spare roll. This is not a case for asking the experienced volunteers to be more available. [[Maintenance]] needs ownership that can survive an ordinary holiday.
